title: 3D Chrome "no internet" dino game with new twists and easter eggs with Opus 5.5
author: Neither-Deer4039
selftext:
Play it here: [https://rex.swikrut.com](https://rex.swikrut.com)



Everything in it (the dinos, the cavemen, all the sounds) is generated in code with Three.js, no image or audio files. It's one HTML file, so once it loads it'll keep working even if you go offline, which felt like the right call for this game.



It's free, no ads, no accounts, no sign up. Let me know what your high score is, or if something feels unfair. I tested the obstacle spawning a lot but I'm sure someone will find a way to break it.



\- Built using Opus 5.5 (medium effort)

\- Claude did all the 3d modeling

\- Even the trailer was made with Opus 5.5
